main_subject.description: The same adult woman with long dark wind-moved hair and minimal natural makeup across nine candid frames.
main_subject.wardrobe: A white short-sleeve crew-neck fitted T-shirt and mid-rise blue jeans with no visible logos.
main_subject.continuity: Keep identity, covered wardrobe, beige studio wall, and soft lighting consistent across every panel.

grid_sequence: Upper-body head turn with hair moving.
Close face-and-shoulder crop with hair crossing the cheek.
Mid shot with one hand near the collarbone.
Mid-full frame with arms lifted in a joyful stretch.
Close crop of hands adjusting a shirt sleeve.
Back-view mid-full turn with hair lifted.
composition_elements.setting: Minimal warm beige studio wall with no props, text, or logos.
composition_elements.layout: Nine equal panels, thin white gutters, no outer border.

lighting_and_atmosphere.lighting: Soft warm diffused side light with gentle falloff; no hard flash.
lighting_and_atmosphere.mood: Casual, airy, imperfect, and quietly energetic.

technical_specs.rendering: Intentional soft focus and restrained motion blur, low-medium contrast, subtle grain, natural body proportions and hands.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a square 3 by 3 contact sheet of nine equal hyper-realistic lo-fi 35mm studio stills of the same adult woman with long dark wind-moved hair, minimal natural makeup, a white short-sleeve crew-neck fitted T-shirt, and mid-rise blue jeans. Use a minimal warm beige wall with no props. Across the nine frames show a head turn, side step, face-and-shoulder crop, tilted close-up, hand near collarbone, joyful arms-up stretch, hands adjusting a sleeve, back-view turn, and a waist-up turn. Keep the identity, fully covered wardrobe, wall, and soft diffused side light consistent. Add thin white gutters, gentle motion blur, soft focus, subtle analog grain, low-medium contrast, realistic hands and anatomy. No readable text, logos, watermarks, or sexualized framing.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, celebrity likeness, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing clothing, lingerie, fetish styling, low-rise exposure, cleavage focus, logos, readable text, watermark, distorted hands, extra limbs, warped face, inconsistent identity, AI artifacts

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Optional identity references must depict a consenting adult. Use them to guide general identity only; all wardrobe and studio elements remain replaceable and unbranded.
